approvers: Tax adviser, lawyer, spouse, house bank, key staff
reason: A free first meeting costs me nothing, so I would let my adviser look at them. But I have never heard of this firm, they have no earlier sellers to vouch for them, and I will not hand over my life's work to an unknown buyer on the strength of a bank letter alone.
objection: No track record and no references. Why should I give my 20 people and my name to a buyer nobody can vouch for, when others will pay more cash at closing?
instead: Keep running the business, list it on nexxt-change, or sell through my adviser to a competitor or a strategic buyer who pays more cash up front.
would_change_my_mind: A verifiable reference, for example a seller of a comparable business or a named, established backer, plus 100% cash at closing at the top of the range, checked by my adviser.
